title: Administration
intro: Manage accounts, invitations and sessions. Every action goes to the audit log, and changes need a fresh code from your authenticator app.
noFinancialData: This panel shows only account, security and activity data — never users' portfolios, transactions, analyses or alerts.
usersIntro: Accounts with role, 2FA state, block and scheduled deletion.
invitationsIntro: One-time sign-up links. A link is shown only once, when it is issued.
sessionsIntro: Active sessions of all accounts: time, IP address and device.

actions.cancelDeletion: Cancel deletion requested by an administrator

help.reset2fa: Only after verifying the person's identity outside the system. The TOTP secret and backup codes are removed.
help.delete: The same process as a GDPR request: the account and its data are deleted after 14 days. The user cannot cancel an administrator's request — only an administrator can.
help.self: This is your account: e-mail change, block, 2FA reset and deletion are not available here.

confirm.title: Confirm action
confirm.role: Change the role of {email} to “{role}”? All sessions of this account end and administrators receive a security alert.
confirm.email: Change {email} to {newEmail}? Both addresses are notified, sessions end and administrators receive an alert.
confirm.block: Block the account {email}? All sessions end.
confirm.reset2fa: Reset 2FA for {email}? Sessions end and the account sets up a new code at the next sign-in.
confirm.delete: Schedule deletion of {email}? After 14 days the account and all data are permanently deleted.
confirm.cancelDeletion: Cancel the deletion of {email}? The user receives an e-mail.
confirm.createInvitation: Issue an invitation for {email} with the role “{role}”?

stepUp.intro: This action needs a fresh confirmation with a code from your authenticator app (valid for 15 minutes).
stepUp.label: Code from the app (6 digits)

result.conflict: This cannot be done: own account, last administrator, address in use or an active request.
result.notFound: Not found — the data may have changed.
result.inviteCreated: Invitation issued. Copy the link now — it will not be shown again:
